use_case_summary: Needlepoint is building an in-app chat assistant embedded in their B2B product. Priority is low-latency streaming to create a realtime typing UX; initial scope is help-center retrieval + short generative replies with contextual product hints. MVP must be cost-controlled and easy to operate (prefer hosted API).
technical_requirements: Streaming output with chunked tokens (React + Node examples required)
P95 turn latency < 200ms (tokens emitted progressively; median target 100ms)
Throughput: 10-30 concurrent users at launch, plan to scale to 200+ over 6 months
Model preference: quantized open model (Llama2-13B) or Redwood-curated low-latency profiles; automatic fallback to 7B variant on overload
Observability: token-level cost breakdown, per-route latency, per-user quota monitoring
Security: SSO admin access, audit logs retention 90d, simple KMS integration (optional)
Deployment: public cloud (no VPC/on-prem needed for MVP)

Week 1: Integrate hosted API with frontend streaming SDK (React) and Node backend
